result.title: CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition
result.summary: Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CHORD，两阶段 rectified-flow 框架生成文本驱动的 3D 人-物交互动作：第一阶段用每时间片 12 个 part token 联合规划物体 6-DoF 轨迹、接触状态与各运动链的首末端关节，并在每个 flow step 用闭式 clean estimate 解码交互、与物体表面比对后把反馈路由回对应 token；第二阶段固定该计划并补全其余肢体与手指关节。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「紧凑 part token 计划 + 闭式估计解码 + 表面测量反馈回路由到责任 token、零额外前向」可能在方法上可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何被证据测量并局部修正、以及贡献分配与停止/迭代决策的线索，但领域为动作生成，与 VLM 推理距离较远。
